title: The Typical day at the mill
subtitle: 社区社会 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 社区社会（社会服务与人际沟通·社区与社会参与）
meta: 主题语境：社区社会（社会服务与人际沟通·社区与社会参与）　|　核心词汇：typical　|　正文 346 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 typical 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1954 the ranger wrote of ① a typical day at the mill in the survey, and everybody in the valley said at once that it was ② more typical than the one named there the year before. Three seasons on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the ranger, who never explained anything, had done it without a word of thanks and gone home; it was the typical ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most typical day at the mill anybody in the valley had ever seen, or so the survey for October 1948 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too typical to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the villager who had come to help; the typical ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the staff at the far ridge, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a typical answer of the old man, and said that no villager in his right mind would call it ⑥ as typical as the answer of the old man they had once had in the old valley. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was typical or not, and he said so.

By 1961 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the survey. What the line asked for was ⑦ something typical, and nothing besides. The villager from the next valley called the whole plan ⑧ quite typical; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the survey kept the names of the typical ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1964, at once, she wrote of another typical day at the mill in the same survey, and the work, which took two seasons, seemed ⑨ more typical than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most typical answer of the old man in the whole valley, she said in 1966, was the one she could never quite name; the typical ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 典型（前置定语 a typical day at the mill：1954 年守林人在踏勘记录里记下的那件典型的一天）
B. adj. 典型／一贯（比较级 more typical than：文中两处，一处比磨坊里典型的一天，一处比预想）
C. adj. 典型／一贯（最高级 the most typical：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 典型（表语 too typical to do：母亲觉得它太典型，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 一贯（前置定语 a typical answer of the old man：叔叔把整件事称作一桩一贯的回答）
F. adj. 一贯（同级比较 as typical as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩老人一贯的回答相比）
G. adj. 一贯（后置定语 something typical：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 一贯（受程度副词修饰 quite typical：那位村民的评价）

items.q: a typical day at the mill
the most typical day at the mill anybody
a typical answer of the old man
The most typical answer of the old man in

answers.why: typical 意为“典型”，1954 年守林人在踏勘记录里记下的是“一件典型的一天”，此处作前置定语 a typical day at the mill。
typical 意为“典型”，此处用比较级 more typical than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
typical 意为“典型”，踏勘记录上 十月 那行字说它是山谷里最典型的一件，故用最高级 the most typical day at the mill。
typical 意为“典型”，母亲认为这件东西“太典型了，谁也用不上”，too typical to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
typical 意为“一贯”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩一贯的回答”，此处作前置定语 a typical answer of the old man。
typical 意为“一贯”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩老人一贯的回答一样一贯”，同级比较用 as typical as。
typical 意为“一贯”，踏勘记录上那半行字要的是“一贯的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something typical。
typical 意为“一贯”，邻山谷来的那位村民认为这套计划“相当一贯”，quite 修饰原级 typical。
typical 意为“一贯”，1964 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要一贯”，故用比较级 more typical than。
typical 意为“一贯”，母亲 1966 年说的是“整个山谷里最一贯的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most typical answer of the old man。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1954 年，守林人在踏勘记录里记下了一件典型的一天。（a typical day at the mill）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更典型。（more typical than …）
母亲觉得它太典型，谁也用不上。（too typical to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩一贯的回答。（a typical answer of the old man）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩老人一贯的回答一样一贯。（as typical as …）
到了 1961 年，踏勘记录上只剩半行字：要的是一件一贯的东西。（something typical）
answers: In 1954 the ranger wrote of a typical day at the mill in the survey.
Everybody said it was more typical than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too typical to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a typical answer of the old man.
He said nobody would call it as typical as the answer of the old man they had once had.
By 1961 the survey asked for nothing but something typical.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 typical 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1954 the ranger wrote of a typical day at the mill in the survey, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most typical day at the mill in the valley, or so the survey says.
My mother thought it too typical to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a typical answer of the old man, and nobody argued with him.
The villager from the next valley called the plan quite typical, and everybody laughed.
The typical ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
